messages:
mike_ops: Heads-up: receiving a surge of 503s for hosted inference (acme-prod) starting ~13:02 UTC. Error rate ~30% on rw-large-v1 pool. Looks like upstream worker crash loop.
sara_support: Customer ticket #ACME-872: timeouts + 503s, high user impact. They provided example request ids. Opening escalation to SRE.
lucas_sre: I pulled recent runner logs — saw abrupt exits with SIGSEGV and immediate container restart. Sequence: heavy batch fanout after model swap. snippet: 
```
2026-03-17T13:01:58Z infer-worker[4123]: [ERROR] CUDA OOM allocating 1.2G for attention_kv
2026-03-17T13:02:00Z infer-worker[4123]: [FATAL] signal 11 (segfault) at 0x7f4b2c...
```
mike_ops: Repro on staging: trigger model variant rollout with quantization to int8 + simultaneous batch_size=8 requests with ~6k tokens -> worker killed.
nora_eng: That rollout included an automated quant-swap we pushed yesterday (rw-large-v1 -> rw-large-v1-int8). We should pause the rollout on hosted-eu-1 and revert to fp16 asap.
lucas_sre: Agreed. Immediate mitigation: 1) rollback model variant on affected pool 2) throttle batch_size to 4 and cap max_context=2048 3) increase eviction threshold to avoid prefetch memory spikes.
sara_support: Noted. Updating customer: "we're rolling back a recent model variant and applying a temporary throttle; will follow up with root cause in 2 hours."
dev-ops-bot: Rollback initiated by @nora_eng on pool hosted-eu-1 for variant rw-large-v1-int8 -> rw-large-v1-fp16. Jobs queued: 4.
lucas_sre: After rollback error rate dropped to baseline for most traffic but seeing a handful of restarts correlated with leftover pods hitting full GPU memory. Suggest a rolling pod recycle to clear KV caches.
mike_ops: Can you collect coredump + nvprof dump from one of the failing hosts? Add to incident artifacts. Also check driver logs for ECC or nvlink resets.
lucas_sre: Collected coredump + heaptrace (linked in incident). Early analysis: OOM during KV prefetch path combined with a kernel launch race leading to segfault. Likely regression in prefetch concurrency after quantization path change.
nora_eng: Prioritized a hotfix branch to gate prefetch concurrency and add extra checks before quant-swap. If hotfix looks safe we can rollout to staging.
james_cs: CS note: please waive tokens for ACME window 13:02-13:25 and add an entry to support FAQ explaining temporary throttles. I'll handle customer comms.
lucas_sre: Next actions: produce minimal repro (small batch with long context + quant-swap), run under asan build on repro nodes, validate hotfix. If repro stable, schedule hotfix deploy to hosted-eu-1 with canary 5%.
sara_support: I've assigned follow-up tasks in ticket and set customer expectation. Closing update for now — will post postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
